join_us.title: Interested in the work of Wang Lab?
join_us.intro: Wang Lab studies skeletal muscle stem cells and the tissue environment that supports repair, with related work on aging, cellular senescence, genome regulation and multi-omics.

sections.label: Research environment
sections.title: Questions across muscle biology
sections.body: The lab’s public research record spans muscle stem-cell biology, regeneration, aging and sarcopenia, cellular and molecular mechanisms, genomics, multi-omics and computational approaches.

sections.label: Approaches
sections.title: Connected experimental and computational work
sections.body: Published work includes studies of cell state and niche signaling, RNA and genome regulation, human muscle profiling and intervention questions in defined research models.

join_us.contact_text: If you are interested in this research, please contact the lab with your CV and research interests.
